description: Core defaults plus the notification set. The notification line is not optional once tauri-plugin-notification is registered: the plugin polyfills window.Notification onto its own IPC command, so the probe page calls through the ACL without containing a line of Tauri code. Granting core:default alone made Notification.requestPermission() reject with 'notification.request_permission not allowed' on Windows 2026-09-11, which looked from the outside like a webview that lacked the API. Write a capability file against the plugins registered, not against the code the page appears to contain.
